_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Yu pleyim Golf (Kad Gem) - Pleya {player_id}.
Goel: Kamap na skor lais long dis wanpela raun. Sapos kolom i sharim sem vailu, ol i kamap 0.
Vailu bilong Kad: A=1, 2-10=vailu bilong em yet, J/Q=10, K=0

Aksions (usim breket eksak): 
- '[draw]' - Drawim long dek 
- '[take]' - Tekim long discard pil 
- '[swap X Y]' - Switim kard bilong yu drawim wantaim posisen X (row) Y (kolom) 
- '[discard]' - Rausim kard bilong yu drawim

board.drew:
Yu drawim: {card}
Nau yu mas [swap X Y] o [discard] em.
board.took: Yu kisim: {card} long ol samting yu tromoi, na nau yu mas [swap X Y] wantaim em (yu no inap rausim).

options.final_turns: Tans bilong las! Opshon bilong yu: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Yu mas: [swap X Y] (no ken rausim ol kat long hap bilong tromoi)

message.deck_empty: Pail bilong kadi emti! Gem i pinis kwiktaim.
message.knocked: Man {pid} i paitim em! Ol narapela man tu inap kisim wanpela taim moa.
message.final_round: Pleya {pid} {reason}! Ol narapela pleya i gat wanpela turn moa.

reason.all_revealed: i lukim ol kadi bilong em

invalid.wrong_action: Usim wanpela aktibiti bilong breket: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], o [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Ol samting bilong rausim i no stap!
invalid.must_draw_first: Yu mas [draw], [take], [knock], o [peek X Y] pastaim
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Yu no ken rausim kadi yu kisim long pail bilong kadi. Yu mas swip.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Yu gat drawn kadi. Yu mas [swap X Y] o [discard] em.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Yu mas kisim wanpela kat bilong senisim.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Yu mas i gat wanpela samting bilong yu yet long mekim.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posisen i go longwe. Usim row 1-{max_row}, kolom 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Yu no ken knock wantaim kadi yu kisim. Komplitim raun bilong yu pastaim.
invalid.already_knocked: Wanpela i bin winim dispela pait.
